what: Instead of the system cursor, a 16px heart outline follows the mouse with exponential easing at 14 per second. Links, buttons and petting spots ([data-fx-part=pet]) Over it, it grows to 1.25x in .16s and fills with the accent color, and shrinks to .85x while pressed. When stepping onto pet or pressing it, small hearts (up to five) bloom 18px above that spot, from .4 to .85~1.15x in .18s, float 30~40px upward (±9px sideways) over 1.05s, and fade out over .55s starting at .5s

options.hot · down: Scale over link and pressed scale, default 1.25 · .85
options.[data-fx-part=pet]: Spot where a heart floats up on hover or press (original is a bee on a flower)
options.--fx-size · --fx-drop · --fx-ink · --fx-: (css variable) cursor · rising heart size, border and fill color

from.where: index.html .rw-heart · .rw-drop (original .heart 16px, transition transform .16s ease-press, is-hot 1.25x · pressed .85, five heart-drop: .18 press at .85~1.15, 1.05 settle 30~40px up, from .5s .55 power1.in — when hovering over or pressing the bee)

note: The original judges by the bee’s (3D) on-screen position and floats the heart above the bee’s head. The Motion part floats it 18px above the cursor position over the pet element. It is not attached on devices without a pointer or with reduced motion (the system cursor stays as is)
